## Journal

[Law and Human Behavior®](https://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/lhb) This journal is a multidisciplinary forum for the publication of articles and discussions of issues arising from the relationships between human behavior and the law, the legal system, and the legal process.

Links to available calls for papers or submissions can be found on our social media feeds.

## Scientific Review Papers

The AP-LS Scientific Review Paper committee works to approve official Scientific Review Papers that are meant to objectively summarize the research literature in areas where there is a high degree of scientific clarity and consensus.

In its history, the Executive Committee has only approved three official Scientific Review Papers of the American Psychology-Law Society. Links to view each paper online and to download it as a pdf are included here below. 

If you have any questions, contact the [AP-LS Scientific Paper Committee](../about/committees.html). 

::: about-link
[Learn more about the selection process](https://psycnet.apa.org/fulltext/2020-06220-001.html)
:::

## Newsletter

### AP-LS Newsletter

AP-LS Newsletter connects the psychology-law community with activities, events, and resources.

AP-LS News This newsletter was replaced by the AP-LS E-Newsletter and ceased production in 2018. HTML and PDF versions of the AP-LS News are available on the Past Issues page.

## Book Series

AP-LS sponsors a book series, edited by Dr. Monica Miller and published by APA Books. One of the society's goals is educating the psychology and legal professions and the general public about important developments in the field of psychology and law. The focus of the book series reflects the diversity of the field of psychology and law as we will publish books on a broad range of topics. Published series books are described and available for purchase.

::: callout-note
#### Do you have a proposal for a new book in this series?

The series editor welcomes submissions of proposals for new books in this series. The society is interested in publishing scholarly work that advances the field of psychology and law by contributing to its theoretical and empirical knowledge base. The series editor will consider proposals in any area of psychology and law. If you would like more information about submitting a proposal, please contact the book series editor, [Monica Miller](mailto:mkmiller@unr.edu).
:::

For all of the books within the prior series, please visit the [Oxford University Press AP-LS book series page](https://global.oup.com/academic/content/series/a/american-psychology-law-society-series-plp/?cc=ca&lang=en&).

## Other Publications

You may also be interested in following other journals & books, not associated with AP-LS, that also publish about issues relevant to psychology and law.

If there is a publication you think should be added to this list, please contact the AP-LS Web Editor {{< fa envelope title="Email" >}} {{< var email.web >}}.

# ── Pill renderer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pill <- function(open) {
  if (open) {
    tags$span(
      style = paste(
        "display: inline-block;",
        "padding: 3px 10px;",
        "border-radius: 12px;",
        "font-size: 0.75rem;",
        "font-weight: 700;",
        "background-color: #2ecc71;",
        "color: #ffffff;"
      ),
      tags$i(class = "bi bi-unlock-fill me-1"),
      "Open Access"
    )
  } else {
    tags$span(
      style = paste(
        "display: inline-block;",
        "padding: 3px 10px;",
        "border-radius: 12px;",
        "font-size: 0.75rem;",
        "font-weight: 700;",
        "background-color: var(--apls-primary);",
        "color: #ffffff;"
      ),
      tags$i(class = "bi bi-lock-fill me-1"),
      "Subscription"
    )
  }
}

# ── Table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

reactable(
  data,
  searchable          = TRUE,
  pagination          = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize     = 25,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  highlight           = TRUE,
  defaultColDef = colDef(
    vAlign      = "center",
    headerClass = "header"
  ),
  columns = list(
    Name = colDef(
      name     = "Journal",
      minWidth = 350,
      cell     = function(value, index) {
        tags$a(
          href   = data$link[index],
          target = "_blank",
          value
        )
      }
    ),
    open_access = colDef(
      name     = "Access",
      minWidth = 140,
      align    = "center",
      cell     = function(value) pill(value)
    ),
    link = colDef(show = FALSE)
  ),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    color                 = "var(--apls-fg)",
    backgroundColor       = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
    borderColor           = "var(--apls-border)",
    stripedColor          = "var(--apls-card-bg-alt)",
    highlightColor        = "var(--apls-bg-alt)",
    inputStyle = list(
      backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
      color           = "var(--apls-fg)",
      borderColor     = "var(--apls-border)"
    ),
    searchInputStyle = list(
      backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
      color           = "var(--apls-fg)",
      borderColor     = "var(--apls-border)"
    ),
    headerStyle = list(
      background    = "var(--apls-primary)",
      color         = "var(--apls-nav-fg)",
      borderColor   = "var(--apls-border)",
      textTransform = "uppercase",
      fontSize      = "1rem",
      fontWeight    = "600"
    ),
    paginationStyle = list(
      color           = "var(--apls-fg)",
      backgroundColor = "var(--apls-card-bg)",
      borderTop       = "1px solid var(--apls-border)"
    ),
    pageButtonHoverStyle  = list(backgroundColor = "var(--apls-bg-alt)"),
    pageButtonActiveStyle = list(
      backgroundColor = "var(--apls-primary)",
      color           = "var(--apls-nav-fg)"
